verdict.rationale: Google Authenticator is a credential and identity tool, and products of that kind can plausibly issue scoped credentials to agents, so the axis applies. The evidence covers only TOTP/HOTP code generation, device sync, QR transfer and a PAM module. Nothing shows the product issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials for an agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
